description: Refurbishment of Elections Secretariat Building at Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President to effect structural additions to the Elections Secretariat at a total cost of Rs.42.54 million, to provide better facilities, and to entrust the work to the Department of Buildings, was approved by the Cabinet.
